caption: Spinach French toast 🤍 Quick, easy, and perfect for busy days. Ingredients: • 2 slices whole grain bread • 1 egg • Splash of milk • Handful spinach • 1 tbsp mozzarella • 1 tbsp cheddar • Butter Directions: Blend everything → dip bread → cook in butter until golden.
